.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r6/task/tests/** (criterion/prompt text, for n-gram overlap comparison only)
evidence: environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and three /instructions notes (find -type f; no dotfiles). environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty): it COPYs only instructions/ and assets/, never solution/ or tests/, and /app is created with git init plus an empty .gitkeep commit. Actual build (docker build of frozen environment/, tag qc-r6-row16-env:tmp, removed afterwards) confirmed /app holds only .git and the 0-byte .gitkeep (single commit 'Initialize task workspace'), /instructions and /assets hold exactly the 3 notes and seed_data.json, global node_modules has only express, better-sqlite3, npm, corepack, and no server.js/app.db/solve.sh/toml exists outside /usr. seed_data.json holds raw inputs only (accounts, matters, raw messages with at/hold/parent/versions, walled list, read_up_to); it does not precompute timer-expired deletions (e.g. K-1 at 2026-05-01 on a 7-day matter is still present raw), visible-per-user lists, transcripts, schema, routes or UI. The notes describe product behaviour in user language; integration.md names only the template runtime contract (GET /api/health, port, DB_PATH), not a route list or schema. Grep finds no rubric/criterion/judge/grader/verifier/score vocabulary in instruction.md or environment/. A 10-gram overlap scan of instruction.md + notes + seed vs all tests/ text found only seed-message quotes ('Here is the original lease scan, clause 14...', 'Clause 14 noted...') and the account table repeated in tests/app_context.md, i.e. criteria quoting inputs, not notes reproducing criteria. Broken-app/alternative probe: an agent cannot copy any finished app, schema or expected-outcome table from the image, so a weak app gets no free credit; a conforming alternative is not constrained by any leaked skeleton.
